evidence: Rule (workbook Quality Checks row 12 / D13; quality-checks.md:54; staged-task-contract.md:78): [environment].docker_image must be absent while the agent Dockerfile has active build steps. Frozen task/task.toml:20-24 is the whole [environment] table: 'build_timeout_sec = 600.0', 'network_mode = "public"', 'cpus = 2', 'memory_mb = 4096' - no docker_image key. Parsing the file with tomllib and walking every table found no key containing 'image' (and no allow_internet) anywhere, including [verifier.environment] (task.toml:37-38, only network_mode). A grep for 'docker_image' over the frozen task's toml/yaml/sh/md files returned no match; no docker-compose file exists in the task and the only other toml files are tests/scoring.toml and the five judge.toml files. The agent Dockerfile has active build steps that would be dead code if an image were set: environment/Dockerfile:1 'FROM node:22-bookworm-slim', :5-7 apt-get install, :9-12 'npm install -g ... express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1', :14-15 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/' and 'COPY assets/ /assets/', :16-23 git workspace init. The [environment] block through end of file and the agent Dockerfile are byte-identical to the frozen template, which also sets no docker_image. Counter-checks tried: (a) a prebuilt image declared under another table or key spelling - none found by the full-tree key walk; (b) a conforming alternative wrongly failing - not applicable, the rule constrains only this one key. This row is a static property of task.toml, so no runtime measurement is required for it; the raw-evidence index contains no harness build of the agent image (the scripted runs used a locally tagged verifier image), so there is no run to confirm against, hence run_verdict NOT EXERCISED. That does not weaken the static finding.
